name: Clean a Messy Excel File Using n8n

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $input.first().json;

const report = [
  "CUSTOMER DATA CLEANING REPORT",
  "============================",
  "",
  `Total Rows Imported: ${s["Total Rows Imported"]}`,
  `Empty Rows Removed: ${s["Empty Rows Removed"]}`,
  `Invalid Emails Removed: ${s["Invalid Emails Removed"]}`,
  `Invalid Phones Removed: ${s["Invalid Phones Removed"]}`,
  `Duplicate Rows Removed: ${s["Duplicate Rows Removed"]}`,
  `Invalid Dates Blank: ${s["Invalid Dates Blank"]}`,
  `Final Row Count: ${s["Final Row Count"]}`,
  "",
  "Status: Cleaning completed"
].join("\n");

return [{json: {report}}];
